qrels_and_denominators.fact_group_coverage: Per-item fact_evidence_coverage and generation_context_fact_evidence_coverage require all units in one evidence group within the supplied chunk set.
qrels_and_denominators.evaluation_helper_distinction: evaluation.retrieval_metrics() remains a separate flattened evidence-unit diagnostic: any chunk covering any evidence unit is relevant. It is not comparable to the fact-group qrels used by derive_gold_matrix.py and must not be combined under one metric label.
qrels_and_denominators.no_defect: The distinction is intentional for this matrix task and is documented in the scoring report; source-span interval semantics are shared.
